programme.desc: Languedoc-Roussillon is France's largest wine region and has more organic vineyard land than anywhere else on the planet! Biodynamic winemaking pioneer Gérard Bertrand takes center stage, highlighting why caring for the planet and producing incredible wines aren't mutually exclusive.
